description: This file defines the AclValidator class, which provides functionality to validate Access Control Lists against required permissions within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating validator instances, performing validation checks, and retrieving validation reasons.

classes.name: AclValidator
classes.description: A final, immutable class used to validate an AccessControlList for minimum permissions requirements. It checks for completeness and authorization subject permissions.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new AclValidator instance with specified ACL and permissions. Ensures non-null arguments.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs validation on the ACL, checking for emptiness, single entry correctness, and existence of authorized subjects with required permissions. Returns validation result.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an optional explaining why validation failed, if applicable.
